goal: Maximise historical predictive accuracy without leakage.

leakage_policy.training_outcomes: only matches completed before forecast cutoff
leakage_policy.sporting_features: reconstructed only from league results completed before cutoff

T30.selection_rule: candidate and weight selected on 2022/23-2023/24 dev only
T30.reason: Positive dev and holdout sign, but holdout gain is only ~0.6% and confidence interval still crosses zero.

T7.selected_challenger: v1.7 + prior-season early-stage residual correction (first 3 home matches, shrink k=1)
T7.reason: Improvement is below 1% overall and compatible with noise.

nonlinear_result: LightGBM/XGBoost-style direct models materially underperformed v1.7 on the same strict as-of setup.

popularity_research.note: Prior-season opponent popularity remains a separate T30 research signal. Best dev-selected family does not clearly improve dev; therefore not promoted despite better later-season historical results.

conclusion: On full historical OOS coverage, algorithm complexity is not the bottleneck. v1.7 remains champion; material gains are more likely to come from new demand information such as genuine as-of ticket signals.
